intent_record.intent_summary: Enable correct LBR virtualization state preservation in SVM VMRUN state copying.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional block checking kvm_cpu_cap_has(X86_FEATURE_LBRV) which invokes svm_copy_lbrs and clears reserved bits in the debug control register.
intent_record.how: Ensures Last Branch Record state and debug control settings are correctly preserved during VMRUN state copying on CPUs supporting LBR virtualization.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes LBR MSR reads to only return valid data when LBR virtualization is enabled, preventing access to branch record information when the feature is disabled
intent_record.what: Modified five MSR read cases (MSR_IA32_DEBUGCTLMSR, MSR_IA32_LASTBRANCHFROMIP, MSR_IA32_LASTBRANCHTOIP, MSR_IA32_LASTINTFROMIP, MSR_IA32_LASTINTTOIP) to conditionally return VMCB save values only when lbrv is true, otherwise returning 0
intent_record.how: Prevents guests from reading Last Branch Record (LBR) related MSRs when LBR virtualization is not enabled, ensuring these registers return 0 instead of potentially stale or invalid VMCB data when the feature is disabled

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing debug and branch/interrupt tracking MSRs to the base MSR save list to ensure complete state preservation
intent_record.what: Added four new MSR entries to the msrs_to_save_base[] array: MSR_IA32_DEBUGCTLMSR, MSR_IA32_LASTBRANCHFROMIP, MSR_IA32_LASTBRANCHTOIP, MSR_IA32_LASTINTFROMIP, and MSR_IA32_LASTINTTOIP
intent_record.how: Enables proper saving and restoring of debug control and last branch/interrupt record MSRs during context operations, ensuring complete hardware state preservation

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement exposes host CPU state (sysenter_esp_hi) to guest VMs through MSR read operations without proper validation. In KVM SVM, MSR reads can leak sensitive host information to unprivileged guests if not properly sanitized. The sysenter_esp_hi register contains host stack pointer high bits which could reveal host memory layout information, enabling potential privilege escalation or information disclosure attacks.
